name: job-application-bot
description: Discovers remote customer support / telesales / collections roles open to candidates outside the US and Canada, filters out anything requiring US work authorization, tailors a resume summary + note per job with Claude, auto-submits on Greenhouse-hosted postings, and emails a confirmation per application. Everything else routes to skipped_manual_ats instead of guessing. Runs entirely on GitHub Actions (free) + Supabase (free) + Resend (free tier).
